System blueprint

A WhatsApp lead-routing workflow

Give eligible messaging enquiries a clear route to the right person. Structure the conversation, collect only the useful fields, and connect reviewed assistance to visible ownership and reliable follow-up.

Level 2Choose a capability

Messages can become disconnected from the customer record and the people who should respond. A useful messaging workflow needs clear eligibility, approved conversation paths, timely ownership, and a safe way to escalate uncertainty.

Useful outputs

  • A reviewed conversation and qualification map with channel eligibility rules.
  • A tested routing and CRM handoff workflow with named owners.
  • An operator queue for failed, unanswered, or uncertain cases.
  • A monitoring and recovery guide for the selected messaging setup.

Inputs we need

  • Approved WhatsApp Business access, provider configuration, and eligible communication rules.
  • Enquiry categories, required fields, CRM keys, locations, and routing owners.
  • Business hours, escalation policy, approved messages, and representative test conversations.
Level 3Explore a focus

Define the conversation

Map the enquiry types, approved messages, required fields, business hours, and handoff rules. Confirm the WhatsApp Business setup and provider-specific API and template requirements.

  • Escalate incomplete, conflicting, unsupported, or low-confidence cases to a person.

  • Approve conversation content and test whether the required fields are useful and proportionate.
  • Review classification examples and escalation behaviour before enabling AI assistance.
  • Check that an owner can recover a failed handoff and find its event history.

Route and assist

Connect eligible incoming events to agreed routing rules and CRM records. Use bounded AI assistance only for supported classification or drafting, with uncertainty and exceptions sent to an owner.

Monitor the handoff

Give operators a queue for unanswered, failed, or escalated enquiries. Review processing success, response ownership, and downstream qualification rather than assuming a delivered message resolves the need.

Implementation outputs

  • An enquiry record linked to the approved customer or account identity.
  • A visible operator queue with ownership, next action, and exception reasons.
  • A handoff report and runbook for routine operation and provider failures.

Human expertise

Own the judgment.

The team approves message templates, channel eligibility, conversation content, and routing policy. People own sensitive enquiries, uncertain interpretation, escalation, and relationship decisions.

AI assistance

Support the process.

AI may classify an enquiry or prepare a response from approved information. It should acknowledge insufficient evidence and pass unsupported cases to the responsible person.
